h1: President Hotel Udon Thani — a hotel near Udon airport with a free shuttle and a pool at an easy price
intro: If your flight lands in Udon late, or you have to fly out before dawn, the best value usually isn't a hotel downtown but somewhere just a few minutes' drive from the airport — and President Hotel Udon Thani is one of the options guests bring up for exactly this reason · It's a 3-star hotel on Amphoe Road, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani, about 5 kilometers from Udon Thani International Airport, with a free airport shuttle running 24 hours · Opened in 2008 and renovated in 2022, it has 79 rooms of about 24 sqm with balconies, an outdoor pool, a Thai restaurant, free parking, and bicycles to borrow · Guests rate it highly for cleanliness, staff, and value · From around THB 900/night, rated 9.1 from 243 reviews on Trip.com.

body.html: Who President Hotel Udon Thani is for — to put it as simply as possible, President Hotel Udon Thani is a hotel for people who care most about flight convenience and value, rather than chasing a spot in the middle of the city's shopping district · It isn't a big chain hotel attached to a mall, and it isn't a heavily designed boutique hotel built for photos, but a compact 3-star hotel planted on Amphoe Road, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani, in the area near Udon Thani International Airport · It has been open since 2008 and went through its most recent renovation in 2022, which makes many parts look fresher than the building's actual age · It's still open today and performing well, with a score of about 9.1 from 243 reviews on Trip.com and high-8s to low-9s on other booking platforms too · Real reviews line up on who fits here: travelers with flights in and out of Udon at awkward hours, whether landing late or flying out before dawn, people on a short errand who have to head back quickly, families driving through who want a quiet place with parking, and budget travelers who want a clean room with a pool for the high hundreds to low thousands of baht · The group that may feel it isn't quite right is people who intend to walk around the downtown shops every day, or who want a hotel where you step out the door and hit a night market right away, because this place sits a fair distance from the main commercial area · To paint the picture, President Hotel is a good "stopover" hotel that does its job in a straightforward way at an easy price, rather than a destination you stay at for the hotel itself.

Location and getting around — the number-one selling point of President Hotel Udon Thani is how close it is to the airport · The hotel is at 253/3 Amphoe Road, Mak Khaeng, Mueang Udon Thani, and is only about 5 kilometers from Udon Thani International Airport (UTH), or roughly a 10–15 min drive, which is a real advantage for frequent flyers · What sets it apart from ordinary places to stay is the free airport shuttle that runs 24 hours — many reviews mention this as the first reason they chose it, because there's no taxi fare and no gamble finding a ride late at night; you just contact the hotel ahead of time and a car comes for you · In terms of getting into town, the main commercial areas like Central Plaza Udon Thani and UD Town are about 3 kilometers away, or roughly a 10 min drive, while Nong Prajak Park, the central city park, and Udon Thani railway station are also within about a 10–15 min drive · The honest caveat is that this isn't a hotel you can walk from to a mall or night market; getting into town means calling a car or driving · But the trade-off is that the area is fairly quiet and far less hectic than the city center, which suits people who actually want to rest · For those driving themselves, the hotel has free on-site parking, which is an advantage since parking in central Udon can be hard to find when it's busy · There are free bicycles to borrow for riding around the neighborhood, and an EV charging point, which is still not easy to find at a hotel in this price range.

"We picked this place because our flight landed late, and there's a free airport shuttle — we called and a car came right away, no scrambling for a ride at night · The room was clean, the bed was comfortable, the staff were really kind, and there was breakfast in the morning too. Great value for the price."

Room types and decor — President Hotel Udon Thani has 79 rooms in total, most of them around 24 square meters, which is a good fit for a 3-star hotel at this price · The room types are split into several options to suit the number of guests and the budget, starting with the Standard Room and Superior Room as the entry-level rooms, moving up to Superior Double, Superior Twin, Deluxe Double, and Deluxe Twin, where you can choose one big bed or two twin beds · A detail many reviews like is that most rooms have a private balcony, and some look out onto the garden or pool, which feels more relaxing than a closed-in room · The decor is in warm, simple tones, the style of a well-kept provincial hotel — nothing flashy, but easy on the eyes · Rooms come with air conditioning, a fridge, a TV, a desk, drinking water, and a private bathroom with a shower · Reviews agree that the rooms are clean, the beds more comfortable than expected, and they've been well maintained since the 2022 renovation, especially on cleanliness, which scores around 9.4 on booking platforms · To be fair, some reviews note that certain rooms are starting to show signs of the building's age since it opened in 2008 — a few power outlets that don't work, a musty smell in rooms that don't get used much, and partition walls that don't fully block sound, so you sometimes hear the room next door · If you care about newness or quiet, it's worth asking for a recently renovated room or one facing the garden when you book or check in.

Facilities, the pool, and common areas — as a mid-sized 3-star hotel, President Hotel's common areas are good value for the price · The highlight is the outdoor pool set among a garden and poolside chairs, a popular spot for guests who want to unwind after traveling or before heading out, and families with kids can swim too · Around the pool there are terraces and a deck to sit with a drink and catch the cool evening breeze · The hotel also has services that fully cover getting around — a free 24-hour airport shuttle, free parking, free bicycles to borrow for a ride, and an EV charging point · There's free Wi-Fi everywhere, a 24-hour reception, room service, and a small bar for an evening drink, with live music on some nights · To be straight about it, there's no large fitness center or spa like a 4–5 star hotel, and the pool is more for relaxing and letting kids play than a long pool for serious lap swimming · But overall, for a 3-star hotel near the airport at this price, it delivers more facilities than expected, especially having a pool and a free shuttle together in one place, a combo that isn't easy to find on this budget.

Food and dining — food is another area where President Hotel Udon Thani gets consistent praise in reviews · The hotel has a restaurant called U-SPACE that mainly serves Thai food, with a casual family-restaurant feel, open from late morning through dinner · A point many people mention is the breakfast included in the room rate, which reviews describe as varied and filling, with Thai dishes, local Isan dishes, and basic international options to choose from, suiting both Thai and foreign guests · For a hotel at this price, a well-done breakfast included is a plus that adds to the value · There's a small bar for an evening drink, with soft live music on some nights for a relaxed atmosphere · For balance, because the location is outside the commercial area, there aren't as many dining options within walking distance of the hotel as there would be downtown; if you want varied food or famous Isan street food, you may need to call a car into town or order delivery · But for breakfast and easy meals at the hotel, U-SPACE does its job well and means you don't have to go anywhere on a night when you're tired from traveling.

Service — service is one of the most praised aspects in the real reviews of President Hotel Udon Thani · The front-desk team and reception staff come up often as friendly, smiling, and more helpful than expected for a hotel at this price, whether arranging the airport shuttle, fast check-in and check-out, helping call a car into town, or recommending restaurants and places to visit · Many reviews put the service score in the low 9s, which is a key reason guests come away impressed and return · Being a small hotel means the staff can look after guests thoroughly, with the warm, personal feel of a provincial hotel · That said, to be honest, a few foreign reviews note that there's sometimes a bit of an English-language barrier, but most issues get sorted out thanks to the team's willingness to help · Overall, service is a strength that holds the experience here at a good level and is the main reason the overall score is high.

What real reviews say (praise and gripes) — pulling together Trip.com, Booking.com, Agoda, and TripAdvisor, the picture is fairly consistent · On the praise side: the most mentioned thing is how close it is to the airport and the free 24-hour airport shuttle, which helps a lot with late or pre-dawn flights, plus clean and reasonably spacious rooms, comfortable beds, friendly and helpful staff, varied and filling breakfast, a pool and free parking, and above all the value for the price — many conclude they got more than they paid for from a 3-star hotel · On the gripes side: the most common point is the location outside the commercial area, needing to call a car about 10 minutes into town for shopping or the night market, the partition walls that don't fully block sound so you sometimes hear the room next door, a few non-working power outlets in some rooms, a musty smell in rooms that don't get used much, and the plumbing in some rooms where the temperature or taps are inconsistent with the building's age · Some reviews also mention some airplane noise since it's in the area near the airport, though most say it doesn't disturb sleep much · These gripes are mostly things you can manage by choosing your room and setting expectations to match the price, rather than big problems that ruin the overall experience.

"The room was clean, the staff were so lovely, and there was a filling breakfast in the morning · The only downside is it's a bit far from the malls, so you have to call a car into town, but if you're just stopping over before a flight it's a great fit. Good value — next time I'm in Udon I'll stay here again."

Price and value — the starting price for Standard and Superior rooms is around THB 900/night in the normal range, rising to about THB 1,200–1,400 when it's busy or there's an event in town · The roomier Deluxe rooms or ones with a pool view are around THB 1,100 and up · At this price, President Hotel sits in the budget group of hotels but gives you more than rivals on the same budget · Compared with similarly priced places in the area near Udon airport or on the city's outskirts, many of which give you just a bedroom and Wi-Fi, President Hotel's clear advantage is having a pool, breakfast included, a free airport shuttle, and free parking together for the high hundreds to low thousands of baht · Compared with a 4-star hotel downtown like Centara Udon, which starts at around THB 1,200 and up, President Hotel loses on location and the polish of its common areas, but wins on a lighter price and a quieter area · For people who care about easy flights, parking, and a tight budget, the value here pays off fully · Those focused on walking to malls and the night market every day may need to add the cost of getting into town when working out the value · Prices in the cool season (December–February), which is high season for Isan and a time of events in town, tend to rise and rooms fill up fast, so it's worth comparing prices across several platforms before booking.

Good to know before booking — a few things make a stay at President Hotel Udon Thani go more smoothly · One, if you're going to use the free airport shuttle, tell the hotel ahead of time with your flight time and flight number so the car arrives on time, especially late at night or before dawn · Two, if you care about quiet and newer rooms, ask for a recently renovated room or one facing the garden/pool when you book or check in, because some partition walls don't fully block sound · Three, plan your trips into town in advance — if you intend to go to Central or UD Town every day, budget about 10 minutes of calling a car, or use the hotel's free bicycles for short distances · Four, if you're driving yourself, the free on-site parking is an advantage, but note that you need parking when you book · Five, double-check whether the package you book includes breakfast, since breakfast is a point reviews praise and it adds to the value · Six, during the cool season and when there are events in town rooms fill up fast, so book ahead and choose Free Cancellation in case your plans change.

The verdict — from all the real reviews, President Hotel Udon Thani is the best fit for people who care most about flight convenience and value — flights landing late, flying out before dawn, a short errand with a quick turnaround, or driving through and wanting a quiet place with parking · Being about 5 kilometers from the airport, the free 24-hour airport shuttle, the outdoor pool, breakfast included, free parking, and friendly service make it a worthwhile choice among Udon's budget hotels, and the reason guests rate it as high as about 9.1 · The trade-offs to accept are the location outside the commercial area, needing to call a car into town, partition walls that don't fully block sound, and a building that's starting to show its age in spots even after the 2022 renovation · If you intend to walk around the downtown shops every day, or want a luxury hotel with full common areas, this may not be the answer, and you should consider a downtown hotel instead · But for a trip where you want a clean place near the airport, with a pool and a free shuttle at an easy price, President Hotel does that well, and it's the reason guests come back.
